content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the unnecessary check for `filter_dev` when dumping FDB (Forwarding Database) entries. The `filter_dev` was always NULL when dumping FDBs on the device itself, leading to an empty list being returned. By removing this check, the FDB entries installed on the device can be correctly listed in the dump.

Code statements:
- struct net_device *filter_dev;
- if (master && dump->filter_dev != master)
- dump->filter_dev = filter_dev,
